title: 提携解消のお知らせ
notes: First-party CryptoPanda notice states that it ended its partnership with IZAKA-YA after reviewing information raising AML-related concerns and that transactions through an IZAKA-YA wallet connection would no longer be available, while other-wallet transactions would remain available. Used for the partnership termination and transaction-path restriction only; the stated AML concern is a counterparty statement and is not treated as an independently proven finding about IZAKA-YA.
